name: Loewe
why: Craft-surrealism on a Spanish leather foundation.
origin: Madrid, 1846 — a leather workshop older than most countries' fashion industries.
opview: Positions craft — the hand — as the essence of the house.

notes.avant: craft-surrealism — sculpture you can put your arm through
notes.weird: Jonathan Anderson's surrealism, where a bag looks like a pixel and a coat looks like something else entirely. Weird in the art-historical sense rather than the provocative one.
notes.status: Craft-signalling status — leatherwork and surrealism that read to a narrower and more informed room than a monogram would. Recognition here is a test the viewer passes.

cities: NYC, LA, Miami, Vegas · dept stores
